description: Read the transfer of a project's repository to the person's GitHub account: its state, what the person does next, where the repository goes, and when SHIP deletes its archived copy. This tool only reads: SHIP moves the transfer on by itself. The result gives the next step in action: choose_target means the person makes an empty repository on their own GitHub account, installs SHIP's GitHub App on it, and you call transfer_project_repository again with that connection's connectorId and the repository as owner/name. wait means SHIP copies and checks the repository: read the transfer with get_project_transfer after pollAfterSeconds.
name: get_project_transfer

action.description: What the founder does next: name their empty repository with SHIP's GitHub App installed on it, or wait while SHIP copies and checks it.

state.description: `requested` before SHIP checks anything. `awaiting_target` while the founder must name their own empty repository. `mirroring` while SHIP copies every branch and tag into it, and `verifying` while SHIP checks that each one has the same commit. `repointed` when the project uses the founder's repository. `archived` when SHIP's own copy is read-only and waits for its delete, and `done` after the delete. `failed` gives the cause in `failure`. `cancelled` when the founder stopped it before the repoint.

title: Get project transfer
